idea-plugin.name: dev-prune
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the dev-prune icon on .devprune.json and ignore.devprune.json in the project tree.

The files stay ordinary JSON to the IDE, so schema completion and validation — from the $schema link the CLI writes into every file, or from SchemaStore — keep working exactly as before.

dev-prune (devp) reclaims disk space from idle Git repositories by deleting dependency directories — node_modules, .venv, target, vendor and whatever else its twenty-three supported package managers own — only after the project's package manager confirms a lockfile can rebuild them.
